New DEVIL MASTER album 'Bloody Dreams' is out now on LP/CD/CS/Streaming.

The darkest, filthiest alleys of old Philadelphia, DEVIL MASTER arise once more to corrupt the children of light. Between tours and festival appearances, the masters of devilry wrote their third full-length, Bloody Dreams. Punkier, with a psychedelic lean, yet festooned with a feral black metal aura, the album gleams from the abyss. Engineered by Davis M. Shubs and Grammy-nominated engineer Eric Bogacz, Bloody Dreams dances darkly. Tracks “You Worms' Vain Delusions” to “Death Anthem,” “Sex with Succubus,” and the decaying bonnet of “Farewell Waltz to Unfortune's Palace” lead the charge, while guests include Mirai Kawashima (Sigh), former drummer Chris Ulsh (Power Trip), and Ur Èmdr Œrvn (Arkha Sva) enhance DEVIL MASTER's supernatural power.

There is no shadow without light...Bloody Dreams invites you into and out of the abyss.

At the center of Bloody Dreams nests a grandiose re-recording of “Sex with Succubus” – one Devil Master’s first tracks from their debut album Manifestations which hurled them into the eye of the masses. Ringleader Darkest Prince tells, “‘Sex with Succubus’ was added to our live set again at the behest of drummer Wrought by Fathomless Hands and it ended up a perfect addition to this record’s vibe, hearkening back to our beginnings. Being our most ambitious yet, I can’t believe how painless everything seemed, at least on our end… having Arthur [Rizk] back to finally master was the cherry on top.”
